title: Senior Financial Analyst
must_have: 6+ years of experience in corporate finance
text:
Senior Financial Analyst
Hoysala Group | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a senior financial analyst to join our corporate finance team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Ind AS
- Budgeting
- Financial Reporting
- Financial Modelling
- Tally
- 6+ years of experience in corporate finance

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Valuation
- GST Compliance
- Variance Analysis
- Audit

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive annual operating plan with measurable outcomes.
- Drive quarterly board reporting with measurable outcomes.
- Drive monthly close cycle with measurable outcomes.
